name: Taurus — The weight of loving someone s

state.promptText: The weight of loving someone so deeply it scares you.
state.promptAngle: At some point the love stops feeling like freedom and starts feeling like something you cannot survive losing.

script.text: TAURUS DOESN'T DO THIS BY ACCIDENT.
THERE'S SOMETHING SPECIFIC ABOUT THE WAY THEY LOVE AND THE WAY THEY PROTECT THEMSELVES FROM IT.
MOST PEOPLE SEE THE SURFACE. THE SILENCE. THE DISTANCE. THE WAY THEY SEEM UNMOVED WHEN EVERYTHING IS MOVING INSIDE THEM.
THEY LOOK CALM, BUT CALM DOESN'T ALWAYS MEAN UNTOUCHED.
BUT THE REALITY IS FAR MORE COMPLICATED THAN THAT.
AT SOME POINT THE LOVE STOPS FEELING LIKE FREEDOM AND STARTS FEELING LIKE SOMETHING YOU CANNOT SURVIVE LOSING.
SO THEY HOLD ON QUIETLY, EVEN WHEN IT STARTS TO COST THEM PIECES OF THEMSELVES.
THE PEOPLE WHO SEEM THE HARDEST TO REACH ARE USUALLY THE ONES WHO FELT THINGS SO DEEPLY ONCE THEY BUILT SOMETHING AROUND IT.
BECAUSE FOR TAURUS, LOVE DOESN'T PASS THROUGH THEM. IT TAKES ROOT.
AND ONCE SOMETHING TAKES ROOT IN THEM, LETTING GO FEELS LIKE PULLING UP PART OF THEIR OWN HEART.
IT'S THE BRAVEST THING THEY'VE EVER DONE.
AND SOMETIMES THE BRAVEST THING ISN'T STAYING LOYAL. IT'S KNOWING WHEN LOYALTY HAS BECOME A CAGE.
AND MOST PEOPLE NEVER REALIZE THEY WERE WITNESSING IT.
